cloudidentity.groups.memberships.searchD.reason: Searches every group (parent groups/-) for an arbitrary member expression; results carry no customer field, so groups of other customers could be returned.

cloudidentity.groups.memberships.searchT.reason: Searches every group (parent groups/-) for an arbitrary member expression; results carry no customer field, so groups of other customers could be returned.

cloudidentity.groups.memberships.getMemb.reason: Returns an untyped long-running Operation whose response is an arbitrary membership graph across groups that cannot be bound to the customer.

cloudidentity.devices.deviceUsers.lookup.reason: Resolves the calling device's own users from raw hardware and partner identifiers under the separate devices.lookup scope; it is an endpoint agent call, not an admin read of a verified device.

cloudidentity.devices.deviceUsers.client.reason: Writes compliance and health signals that context-aware access trusts, under a partner ID embedded in the name that cannot be verified; a wrong value could grant access.

cloudidentity.inboundSamlSsoProfiles.idp.reason: The body carries identity provider certificate PEM data, which would be stored in the plaintext confirmation proposal and audit; add SAML certificates in the Admin console.
